results.title: Mammootty Praises Rishikanth’s Dorothy; Director Karthik Subbaraj Thanks Him For ‘Encouraging Words’
results.description: Karthik Subbaraj has expressed gratitude to Mammootty after the veteran actor appreciated his latest film, Dorothy. The filmmaker shared pictures with the megastar and the film’s lead actors, Rishikanth and Sananth, thanking him for his wishes and encouraging words.
